summary: Frontend-only redesign (light theme + Poppins + responsive) verified. Login screen renders blue gradient left panel + white form. After admin login (admin@example.com/admin123), every page (Dashboard, List Storage, Manage User, Logs Activity, File Browser) uses light theme (body bg rgb(246,248,252) = #f6f8fc). Body font-family computed as 'Poppins, sans-serif' — no JetBrains Mono. Sticky PageHeader with shadow + page-title testid present on Dashboard/Storages/Users/Logs (Files uses its own header). Desktop (1440x850): sidebar always visible at x=0, w-64. Mobile (390x844): sidebar off-screen (x=-256), mobile-menu-button visible; clicking opens drawer (x=0) with sidebar-backdrop; clicking a nav item closes drawer; tapping visible backdrop area (right of drawer) closes drawer. No horizontal overflow on mobile for /users, /logs, /files (document.scrollWidth == 390 == viewport width). File Browser on mobile shows storages as horizontal chip row above the file list (STAGING S3 / PRODUCTION S3 chips visible). Add Storage dialog opens with white background (light theme confirmed in modals). Manage User page shows admin@example.com (no Access btn — expected), plus other users with Access buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Files page does not use the shared PageHeader component, so it lacks the data-testid='page-title' element that other admin pages have. Minor — consistency only.
PageHeader uses 'lg:sticky lg:top-0' — on mobile the header is not sticky. Acceptable since mobile has its own sticky top bar in Layout, but be aware header shadow only shows sticky on desktop.

Backdrop click via Playwright's default element-center click doesn't close the drawer because the sidebar (z-40) covers the backdrop (z-30) at the center; real touch on the visible backdrop area (right of drawer) works correctly. Not a bug but a subtle test consideration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data-testids for responsive layout: sidebar, mobile-menu-button, sidebar-backdrop, page-title. Existing storages STAGING S3 / PRODUCTION S3 have fake creds so live S3 ops error gracefully (expected). Files page does NOT expose data-testid=page-title. When testing sidebar-backdrop close via Playwright, click by mouse coords in the visible backdrop area (e.g. x=340,y=400 on 390px viewport) rather than element-center of the backdrop, since the sidebar z-index sits above the backdrop and intercepts center clicks.
